desc: Custom-designed Ruger folding Front Sight seamlessly integrates on the Ruger SR-22, the Ruger SR-556, SR-762, AR-556 and any modern sporting rifle with a same-plane Picatinny rail mounting system. This lightweight, polymer sight is elevation-adjustable; folds flat to make room for optics and is spring-loaded to allow for rapid deployment with the push of a button.
